items.q: got a job here for a picture a fellow made about China and used that China music

ctx.x: Yeah, they pretty good. They could read pretty good. They were all right, but that's all we had to db. He and I'd go down there to rehearsal the day that they rehearsed, and they would rehearse the songs and...and the choreographer would put on whatever they going to do--mostly walking, you know, and singing and going on, and we was through for the...until the next week. I mean, they'd give us the story for the next week, and we...and we uh...brought home all our music, and I think we had a lot of that old stuff.…

all the music to "Alabama School Days," and we wrote...uh, a China scene. We wrote a lot of China music--my brother did--and I used that...got a job here for a picture a fellow made about China and used that China music. He called us to...I got a letter in there. I got a letter from him, and he...where he offered...he tried to get me to go to work in the...for the, uh...where you have the...where you have all the, uh, actors that go to get the jobs...broad...general... what is it?
